## Checklist

- [ ] No game assets, dumps, or copyrighted content added (only first-party code/docs)
- [ ] No third-party binaries or SDKs vendored (`tools/bin/`, `unity/Assets/Live2D/` stay git-ignored)
- [ ] No secrets/keystores/absolute paths committed (paths go through `daconfig`/`config.json`)
- [ ] `uv run ruff format tools/` and `uv run ruff check tools/` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior/CLI/DAG changed (`README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`)
